name: Fixture 7: pier to ground plane
note: Spec 5 fixture 7, issue W1-03. Line 1 is a deck between two surfaces at height 2. Line 2 is one vertical pier (member 3) of length 2 from a fixed ground anchor at floor height 0 up to the deck midpoint. All members share section 1. The capacity check treats the pier as fixed at both ends with no sidesway (effectiveLengthFactor K = 0.5): the anchor is fixed, and the deck, fixed at both surfaces, holds the top. The pier has the E, I, and A of the long fixture 4 column, so expectedCriticalLoad (N) matches that column, and its yield strength is high enough that buckling governs. Capacity tests read member lengths from the node positions with no room-to-bridge scale. cy and cz are outer-fiber distances that only the bending check reads.
